decisions.reason: The candidate already requires one randomly assigned $5 commission and one Small Block ticket for each no-referral primary mint; the source changes their accounting in leaderboard and NFT views, not the allocation mechanism.
A same-message MODIFY already fully records that NFT attributes must account for no-referral tickets and commissions and that each ticket must correspond to a $5 commission.
The source addresses operational accounting in leaderboards and NFT attributes and does not request a change to FAQ copy; the existing FAQ already describes random no-referral rewards.
The source does not request About-page copy changes, and the existing copy already states that no-code commissions and tickets are randomly assigned.

The candidate already requires one ticket per successful primary mint, including no-referral and invalid-referral mints; the source concerns missing accounting and backfill rather than ticket issuance or reset rules.
The accounting rule does not change which referral codes are eligible or how referral codes are validated.
The source reports reward-accounting expectations and defects, not a client request to alter Mission-page content.
The source does not change email delivery, notification contents, or reward cash-out guidance.
The existing state already allocates a $5 commission per primary mint; the source concerns representation of commissions in accounting views rather than changing revenue amounts or destinations.
The source does not request any change to landing-page hero content or layout.
Accounting tickets and commissions in leaderboard and NFT views does not change prize payout, collection, or winner-notification behavior.
The source has no effect on the landing-page book-cover display requirements.
